tagline: Grow smarter. Save water. Farm better.
signInToManage: Sign in to manage your farm
voiceWelcomeSpeech: Welcome to Smart Irrigation Planner. Grow smarter, save water, farm better. Choose your language. Sign in with your username and password, or tap Login with Face Lock for instant biometric access. New farmers can tap Create Account to get started.
pageGuideLogin: Welcome to Smart Irrigation Planner. Choose your language. Sign in with your username and password, or use Face Lock for instant biometric access. New farmers can click Create Account.
pageGuideDashboard: Welcome to your Farm Dashboard. Section 1 shows your land summary. Section 2 shows live weather conditions. Section 3 lists your land sections. Section 4 lets you check irrigation and see schedules.
pageGuideOnboard: Please complete your farm setup. Enter your name, select your farm location, and enter your total land in acres. Then review and save your farm.
pageGuidePlanner: To check irrigation, verify your state, crop, and plot area. Adjust soil moisture and weather readings, then click Check Irrigation to view recommendations.
stateLabel: Step 1: Select State or Union Territory
disclaimer: This prediction combines genuine state-wise crop rules with Machine Learning. Always verify field conditions before irrigating.
noIrrigate: DO NOT IRRIGATE — Soil Wet Enough
